description: Integration of experiment tracking and model registry into the training/eval/runner pipeline, plus a CLI management script. Depends on FEAT-001 (experiment.py and model_registry.py must exist).
steps:
1. Modify /root/forge/forge_core/learned_policy.py: update train_bc() to accept optional experiment_tracker and model_registry parameters and return an enhanced TrainResult. Specifically:
   - Add two optional parameters to train_bc(): experiment_id: str | None = None, experiment_tracker: Any | None = None (use Any to avoid hard coupling; the caller passes the ExperimentTracker instance). Do NOT import experiment.py at module level — keep the lazy-import pattern.
   - At the END of train_bc(), after saving the model, if experiment_tracker and experiment_id are both provided, call experiment_tracker.complete_experiment(experiment_id, model_path=save_path, metrics={...}, duration_seconds=elapsed) where metrics dict contains: final_loss, final_val_loss (if val_history), loss_history, val_history, best_epoch, best_loss.
   - Add 'experiment_id: str | None = None' field to the TrainResult dataclass (default None).
   - Set result.experiment_id = experiment_id before returning.
   - If experiment_tracker is provided and training raises an exception, call experiment_tracker.fail_experiment(experiment_id, str(error)) in a try/except wrapper around the training loop.

2. Modify /root/forge/scripts/forge_train.py to auto-log experiments and auto-register models on training completion. Changes:
   - Import ExperimentTracker from forge_core.experiment and ModelRegistry from forge_core.model_registry (at the top, after sys.path setup).
   - In main(), after building the dataset but before calling train_bc():
     a. Create tracker = ExperimentTracker()
     b. Build dataset_info dict: {"n_samples": len(dataset), "source": "from_runs" if args.from_run else "collected", "source_runs": args.from_run or [], "target_object": cfg["target_object"], "task": args.task}
     c. Call experiment_id = tracker.create_experiment(config=cfg, dataset_info=dataset_info, name=f"bc_{args.task}_{timestamp}", tags=[args.task, "bc"])
   - Pass experiment_id=experiment_id and experiment_tracker=tracker to train_bc()
   - After train_bc() returns successfully:
     a. Create registry = ModelRegistry()
     b. Call entry = registry.register_model(name=f"bc_{args.task}", checkpoint_path=result.model_path, experiment_id=experiment_id, description=f"BC policy for {args.task}", metadata={"final_loss": result.final_loss, "epochs": result.epochs})
     c. Print experiment ID and registered model version.
   - Add new CLI flags: --experiment-name (optional override for auto-generated name), --model-name (optional override for auto-generated registry name), --no-track (flag to skip experiment tracking and model registration for backward compatibility).
   - Wrap experiment/registry calls in try/except so that tracking failures print a warning but don't crash training.

3. Modify /root/forge/scripts/forge_eval.py to support loading models from the registry. Changes:
   - Add --registry-model and --registry-version CLI arguments.
   - When --registry-model is provided: import ModelRegistry, call registry.get_model(name, version=args.registry_version), extract checkpoint_path from the entry, and pass it as model_path to create_policy('learned', model_path=checkpoint_path). If model not found, print error and exit.
   - When --registry-model is used, --policy defaults to 'learned' implicitly.
   - Keep backward compatibility: --model-path still works as before.

4. Modify /root/forge/forge_core/runner.py to add a helper function for loading policies from the registry:
   - Add function: load_policy_from_registry(name: str, version: int | None = None, stage: str | None = None, **policy_kwargs) -> Policy. This lazily imports ModelRegistry, looks up the model, resolves the checkpoint path, and calls create_policy('learned', model_path=..., **policy_kwargs). Raises ValueError if model not found.
   - This is a convenience function — not a change to run_task() itself.

5. Create /root/forge/scripts/forge_registry.py — CLI for experiment and model registry management. Use the same CLI patterns as forge_chaos.py and forge_train.py (argparse, setup_logging, sys.path setup). Subcommands via add_subparsers:
   - experiments list [--status STATUS] [--tag TAG]: list experiments in a table (ID, name, status, loss, timestamp)
   - experiments show EXPERIMENT_ID: show full experiment details as formatted text
   - experiments compare ID1 ID2 [ID3...]: side-by-side metric comparison table
   - experiments delete EXPERIMENT_ID: delete an experiment (with confirmation prompt unless --force)
   - models list [--name NAME] [--stage STAGE]: list registered models in a table (name, version, stage, experiment, registered_at)
   - models show NAME [--version VERSION]: show full model details
   - models promote NAME VERSION STAGE: promote a model to a new stage
   - models delete NAME VERSION: delete a model entry (with confirmation prompt unless --force)
   Make the script executable (add #!/usr/bin/env python3 header).

6. Create /root/forge/tests/unit/test_integration_tracking.py with integration-level unit tests that verify the experiment tracking and model registry work together with training. Tests use tmp_path and monkeypatching to isolate from real directories. Test classes:
   - TestTrainWithTracking: test that calling train_bc() with an experiment_tracker creates a completed experiment record with correct metrics and model_path; test that a failed training marks the experiment as failed
   - TestRegistryIntegration: test register_model after training links to experiment; test get_model returns correct checkpoint_path; test load_policy_from_registry returns a working LearnedPolicy
   - TestCLIParsing: test that forge_registry.py's argparse handles all subcommands correctly (import main and check parser behavior, no need to run full CLI)
acceptance_criteria: forge_train.py auto-logs an experiment and auto-registers the model on successful training
forge_train.py --no-track skips experiment tracking and model registration
forge_eval.py --registry-model NAME [--registry-version N] loads from the model registry
load_policy_from_registry() in runner.py resolves a model from the registry and returns a Policy
forge_registry.py experiments list/show/compare/delete all work correctly
forge_registry.py models list/show/promote/delete all work correctly
findings: Integrated experiment tracking and model registry into the training/eval/runner pipeline. train_bc() accepts optional experiment_tracker and experiment_id params — the try/except wraps the entire training body including input guards so even early validation errors are tracked. forge_train.py auto-creates experiments and registers models (--no-track disables). forge_eval.py supports --registry-model/--registry-version for loading from registry. runner.py has load_policy_from_registry() helper. forge_registry.py CLI provides full experiments/models management. 23 new integration tests added, total now 215 tests all passing.
